sources.name: um-general
sources.conclusion: NONE is public; MARKET_DATA is a separate security label requiring a key. The catalogue market-data category alone does not establish authentication.

sources.name: cm-general
sources.conclusion: Same security-label distinction as USD-M; some endpoints require keys, so evaluate this endpoint rather than every market-data API together.

sources.name: um-errors
sources.conclusion: -1121 is BAD_SYMBOL; -1002, -2014 and -2015 describe authorization/key problems. An error code alone does not establish permanent product exclusion.

sources.name: cm-errors
sources.conclusion: Same distinction between BAD_SYMBOL and authorization/key errors.
